title: Free job-search, CV and money advice at Middleton Library today
excerpt: Middleton Library is hosting a free work and skills hub on Monday 9 November, with help for job applications, interviews and managing budgets.
body:
People looking for work or help improving their job applications can attend a free work and skills session at Middleton Library on Monday 9 November 2026.

Rochdale Borough Council lists the session from 9.30am until 12.30pm at Middleton Library, Long Street, Middleton, M24 6DU. No booking is needed and adults can simply turn up.

The council says the hub offers advice on finding vacancies and training courses, completing CVs and application forms, preparing for interviews, and managing debt or household budgets.

The session is described as taking place every other Monday, although residents should check the council's events listing for the next confirmed date rather than assuming every fortnightly date will go ahead.

For someone returning to employment, the most useful starting point may be a CV or a specific application they want help with. Anyone seeking support can bring details of the vacancy or course they are interested in, although the council does not state that any paperwork is required.

The council's listing confirms the session is free. For enquiries, contact middleton.library@rochdale.gov.uk.

Source: Rochdale Borough Council event listing, https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/events/event/579/work-and-skills-hub---middleton-library
summary: Middleton Library is hosting a free work and skills hub on Monday 9 November, with help for job applications, interviews and managing budgets.

title: Rochdale South Township Committee meets on Wednesday: when and where
excerpt: Rochdale South Township Committee is scheduled to meet at Number One Riverside on Wednesday 11 November. Here is how residents can check the agenda.
body:
Residents in the Rochdale South township can check what local councillors are due to discuss when the Rochdale South Township Committee meets on Wednesday 11 November 2026.

Rochdale Borough Council's official meeting calendar lists the meeting for 6pm to 8pm in the Hollingworth room, Room 108ABC, on the first floor of Number One Riverside, Smith Street, Rochdale, OL16 1XU.

Township committees form part of the council's local decision-making arrangements. The specific agenda, supporting reports and any public participation arrangements should be checked on the council's democratic services website before attending. A meeting listing alone does not establish that a particular proposal will be debated or approved.

For residents concerned about roads, neighbourhood facilities or local spending, the practical first step is to review the published agenda and identify the relevant item. If a matter is not on the agenda, it should not be presented as a decision expected at this meeting.

The calendar also lists a Rochdale South Township Delegated Sub-Committee meeting for Wednesday 25 November at 6pm, again at Number One Riverside. That is a separate meeting.

Meeting details may change, so readers should check the council calendar on the day.

Source: Rochdale Borough Council democratic services meeting calendar, https://democracy.rochdale.gov.uk/mgCalendarAgendaView.aspx?C=-1&CID=0&D=6&DD=2026&M=11&MR=0&OT=
summary: Rochdale South Township Committee is scheduled to meet at Number One Riverside on Wednesday 11 November. Here is how residents can check the agenda.

title: Free Heywood Library friendship group offers a place to meet people this Thursday
excerpt: A free drop-in friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November is open to adults, with no advance booking required.
body:
People hoping to make new friends or meet others in their community can attend a free friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November 2026.

Rochdale Borough Council's event listing gives the time as 1.30pm to 3.30pm at Heywood Library, LCpl Stephen Shaw MC Way, Heywood, OL10 1LW.

The gathering is aimed at people aged 18 and over who want to meet new people or learn skills. The council also lists it as suitable for families with children aged four and over, provided children are accompanied by a responsible adult.

No advance booking is required. Visitors can simply turn up. The listing describes it as a regular Thursday activity and says participants can also find out about joining the library and other activities available there.

For residents who have recently moved to Heywood, work from home or simply want more local company, it offers a straightforward way to meet others without committing to a paid course or membership.

For questions, contact heywood.library@rochdale.gov.uk. Check the council listing before travelling in case arrangements change.

Source: Rochdale Borough Council event listing, https://www.rochdale.gov.uk/events/event/996/friendship-group---heywood-library
summary: A free drop-in friendship group at Heywood Library on Thursday 12 November is open to adults, with no advance booking required.
